title: Build simple web chat UI
description: Create static HTML/JS frontend at web/ that calls FastAPI /api/chat. Include message history, source citation display, and responsive design. No framework — vanilla JS for simplicity.
acceptance_criteria: 1) web/index.html functional chat UI 2) Calls /api/chat with X-API-Key 3) Displays sources with doc_id + page 4) Responsive on mobile

title: Build knowledge graph from wiki concepts
description: Parse wiki/concepts/*.md and wiki/summaries/*.md to extract nodes (concepts, documents) and edges (wikilinks, mentions). Implement GET /api/knowledge-graph returning nodes with connection counts and edges with relationship types.
acceptance_criteria: 1) GET /api/knowledge-graph returns nodes array with id, label, type, connections 2) Edges array with source, target, type 3) Graph reflects actual wiki/ structure 4) Response cached for performance

title: Design FastAPI wrapper architecture around OpenKB
description: Design thin FastAPI layer: OpenKBAdapter class wrapping openkb client, Pydantic models for ChatRequest/ChatResponse/Source, dependency injection pattern. Document in api/ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptance_criteria: 1) api/ARCHITECTURE.md describes layer responsibilities 2) Pydantic models defined in api/models.py 3) OpenKBAdapter skeleton in api/openkb_adapter.py 4) No reimplementation of OpenKB internals

title: Initialize OpenKB with German language config
description: Run openkb init with German language, set model to deepseek/deepseek-chat via OpenRouter, configure pageindex_threshold=20, set up .env with LLM_API_KEY.
acceptance_criteria: 1) .openkb/config.yaml exists with language: de 2) .env has LLM_API_KEY set 3) openkb status runs without errors

title: Epic: Project Setup & OpenKB Foundation
description: Phase 1: Initialize OpenKB knowledge base, configure LLM, ingest first batch of KfW/Energieberater documents, establish wiki structure and AGENTS.md conventions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) OpenKB initialized with German language config 2) First documents ingested and wiki compiled 3) AGENTS.md customized for KfW domain 4) openkb chat works end-to-end

title: Create Docker compose setup
description: Write Dockerfile for FastAPI + OpenKB CLI, docker-compose.yml with api and cli services. Mount ./raw, ./wiki, ./cache as volumes. Add .env.example with all required env vars.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dockerfile builds successfully 2) docker-compose.yml has api + cli services 3) Volumes mounted correctly 4) docker compose up starts both services

title: Implement automated lint in CI/CD workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/lint.yml that runs openkb lint on every push to main and on PRs. Fail CI on lint errors. Upload lint report as artifact. Add lint badge to README.
acceptance_criteria: 1) .github/workflows/lint.yml exists 2) Runs openkb lint on push/PR 3) Fails on lint errors 4) Lint report uploaded as artifact

title: Implement /chat endpoint with source citations
description: Build POST /api/chat that calls OpenKB query, extracts source citations (doc_id, title, page, text snippet), returns ChatResponse with response + sources + confidence. Include conversation history support.
acceptance_criteria: 1) POST /api/chat returns response + sources array 2) Sources include doc_id, title, page, text 3) History context passed to OpenKB 4) OpenAPI docs auto-generated at /docs

title: Create raw/ directory structure for KfW documents
description: Create raw/kfws/, raw/sanierung/, raw/berechnungen/, raw/muster/ directories. Add a sample PDF or markdown file to each for testing.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All 4 directories exist under raw/ 2) At least 1 sample file per directory 3) Directory structure matches INTEGRATION_PLAN

title: Epic: FastAPI Wrapper & Chat API
description: Phase 2: Build thin FastAPI wrapper around OpenKB with /chat, /query, /sources endpoints. Add API-key auth, source citation extraction, and intelligence analysis endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: 1) FastAPI server running with /chat endpoint 2) Source citations extracted from OpenKB results 3) API-key auth working 4) /analyze endpoint for kfw_qualification analysis

title: Add health/status monitoring endpoints
description: Implement GET /api/health (liveness), GET /api/ready (readiness with OpenKB check), GET /api/metrics (Prometheus format: request count, latency, OpenKB status). Add /metrics endpoint for monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: 1) /api/health returns 200 with status 2) /api/ready checks OpenKB connectivity 3) /api/metrics in Prometheus format 4) All endpoints documented in OpenAPI

title: Set up Obsidian vault integration for wiki browsing
description: Document Obsidian setup: open wiki/ as vault, enable graph view, configure community plugins (Dataview for querying concepts, Excalidraw for drawing). Add Obsidian-specific instructions to README.
acceptance_criteria: 1) README has Obsidian setup section 2) wiki/ has .obsidian/ config (optional) 3) Graph view documented 4) Dataview queries for KfW concepts documented

title: Implement /analyze endpoint for intelligence analysis
description: Build POST /api/analyze with analysis_type parameter (kfw_qualification, energy_audit, renovation_potential, cost_benefit). Accepts building_context dict, returns structured AnalysisResponse with recommendations, priority, kfw_product references.
acceptance_criteria: 1) POST /api/analyze accepts analysis_type + context 2) Returns recommendations array with priority and kfw_product 3) Sources cited per recommendation 4) Handles unknown analysis_type with 400 error

title: Customize AGENTS.md for KfW/Energieberater domain
description: Write wiki/AGENTS.md with KfW-specific instructions: Förderprogramme (KfW 151-219), Sanierungsnormen (EnEV/GEG), Energieausweis, Fachbegriffe-Disambiguierung, Quellenpflicht für Förderbeträge.
acceptance_criteria: 1) wiki/AGENTS.md exists with KfW domain rules 2) Includes Förderprogramme mapping 3) Includes citation requirements 4) LLM reads it on next openkb add

title: Epic: Knowledge Graph & Quality Assurance
description: Phase 3: Build knowledge graph visualization from wiki concepts, implement lint automation, establish review workflow for KfW domain accuracy, and set up Obsidian integration.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Knowledge graph endpoint returns nodes/edges from wiki 2) openkb lint automated in CI/CD 3) Obsidian vault configured 4) Review checklist for KfW document accuracy

title: Write deployment guide and finalize README
description: Write comprehensive README.md with: project overview, quick start, API docs, deployment (Docker, bare metal), troubleshooting, contributing guidelines. Include architecture diagram and flow description.
acceptance_criteria: 1) README.md complete with all sections 2) Quick start works from scratch 3) Architecture diagram included 4) Troubleshooting section covers common issues

title: Create KfW document accuracy review checklist
description: Create docs/review-checklist.md with criteria for validating KfW/Energieberater content: Förderbeträge verified against official sources, GEG/EnEV references current, KfW program numbers correct, dates and eligibility criteria checked.
acceptance_criteria: 1) docs/review-checklist.md exists 2) Covers Förderbeträge verification 3) Covers normative references (GEG/EnEV) 4) Includes sign-off template for reviewers

title: Write tests for FastAPI endpoints
description: Write pytest tests for /chat, /analyze, /sources/{doc_id}, /status endpoints. Use httpx AsyncClient. Test auth rejection, source citation format, analysis response structure.
acceptance_criteria: 1) pytest tests/ covers all endpoints 2) Auth rejection tested 3) Source citation format validated 4) Tests pass with pytest

title: Add API-key authentication to all endpoints
description: Implement X-API-Key header auth using fastapi.security.APIKeyHeader. Support multiple keys from .env (API_KEY, API_KEYS_DEMO). Return 401 on invalid key. Document auth in README.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All endpoints require valid X-API-Key 2) Multiple keys supported via env 3) 401 returned on invalid key 4) Auth documented in README

title: End-to-end test: openkb chat with KfW questions
description: Test openkb chat with 5 representative KfW/Energieberater questions. Verify answers include source citations, concepts are linked, and no hallucinations on Förderbeträge.
acceptance_criteria: 1) openkb chat runs interactively 2) 5 test questions answered with sources 3) No hallucinations detected 4) Chat sessions persist across runs

title: Ingest first batch of KfW documents into OpenKB
description: Run openkb add ./raw/ to ingest all sample documents. Monitor compilation, verify wiki/concepts/ and wiki/summaries/ are populated. Run openkb lint and fix any issues.
acceptance_criteria: 1) openkb add ./raw/ completes without errors 2) wiki/summaries/ has entries for each document 3) wiki/concepts/ has at least 3 cross-doc concepts 4) openkb lint passes

title: Epic: Web UI & Production Readiness
description: Phase 4: Build simple web chat UI, add Docker deployment, monitoring dashboard, and multi-tenant support preparation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Web chat UI functional 2) Docker compose working 3) Health/status endpoints 4) README with deployment guide
